messages:
Liam: Kicking off NimbusFabric EAP thread. Partner wants a fast bench window, co-listing prep, and explicit telemetry limits. Who owns NDA edits?

Sofia: I can take comms + marketplace copy. Need partner-approved 80-word blurb, logo (SVG/PNG), and a one-line quote. Can we aim for a soft co-list in 3 weeks if perf looks good?

Raghav: I'll run the bench. Lab slot tentative 9/2-9/4 UTC. Hardware: 2x NF-1 boards with partner firmware. Plan: latency suite, mem-heavy, and a 12h soak. Need exact run flags.

Becky: Telemetry constraint from partner: aggregated metrics only, salted hashed request ids OK. No raw prompts or responses. They also ask for 60-day retention and KMS encryption. I'll update ops checklist.

Liam: Good. LegalBot, can you add the hash algorithm and retention language to the NDA addendum?

LegalBot: Draft clause: "Exchange limited to aggregated telemetry and salted cryptographic hashes of request IDs (SHA-256). No plaintext prompts or responses shall be retained or exchanged. Test artifacts retained up to 60 days and stored under customer-managed KMS." Will upload draft in ~2h.

Raghav: Bench flags suggestion: `./bench --model=redwood-7b --seq=2048 --batch=1 --samples=300 --cache=on|off`. Capture `p50,p95,p99,gpu_util_pct,kv_hit_rate,mem_mb`. Save artifacts as `nimbus_eap_<date>_<phase>.json`.

Becky: For telemetry endpoint partner prefers `/metrics/nimbus-eap` with: tokens_total, tokens_per_sec, p95_ms, gpu_util_pct, kv_hit_rate, req_hash_count. Confirming no prompt fragments in logs.

Sofia: I'll draft the marketplace copy and ping partner for logo + quote template. Also propose a joint blog + webinar slot if numbers are strong.

Raghav: Example sanitized run output to include in artifacts: `{"model":"redwood-7b","phase":"warm","p50_ms":32.7,"p95_ms":108.4,"gpu_util_pct":79.2}`. Will ensure artifacts are scrubbed.

Liam: Timeline recap: LegalBot NDA addendum by EOD; Raghav bench runs + upload by 9/4; Sofia blurb + logo chase by 9/6; aim soft co-list 9/20. Sync Mon 9am PT to review artifacts.

Becky: Ops checklist uploaded: `drive.redwood.com/nimbus/eap-playbook.md`. Includes telemetry schema, bench matrix, and repro steps.

Raghav: Will include runbook and reproduce commands. Tag when artifacts live.

LegalBot: NDA draft uploaded to drive. Please review and flag any concerns.

Sofia: Thanks all — keeping this thread as canonical EAP ops for NimbusFabric. :rocket:
